Cross of Christ Lutheran Church
Capital Campaign

These are some of the outreach ministries Cross of Christ supports. Check out how you can help, not just in the north metroo area of Denver, but in the whole world!

A Precious Child – This community organization provides resources to families in need.

Altar Flower Delivery – Each week, members donate flowers so that our worship service can show the beauty of God’s creation while honoring a loved one. After worship, volunteers take these flowers out to local nursing homes.

Broomfield FISH – This community organization provides food, counseling, and other needed services.

God’s Work. Our Hands – In September, we join together for service and education as part of a national ELCA annual effort called “God’s Work. Our Hands.”

Mission Work – Christ calls us to bring the message of Jesus to all people. Because of this, we support missionaries in Jerusalem/West Bank, in partnership with the Rocky Mountain Synod.

New Beginnings – New Beginnings is a Worshipping Community within the Denver Women’s Correctional Facility, whom we help support.

Outreach Team – Our Outreach Team is made up of members from our various outreach ministries. They help implement the mission of Cross of Christ to reach out and care for our neighbors in need.

Sandwiches for the Homeless – Each month, we provide sandwiches, blankets, and needed items to those experiencing homelessness in Denver.

Quilting & Knitting Group – This group meets to create beautiful quilts for Lutheran Family Services, prayer shawls for the church’s ministry, and many other items for people in the local community and around the world.

Little Pantry – Our Little Pantry that can be found on the east end of our parking lot was created as part of an Eagle Scout project. On the first Sunday of each month, Cross of Christ collects non-perishable, non-expired food for the Little Pantry. It is available to anyone who is in need of food.

Community Meals – On the 1st and 3rd Tuesdays of the month, a meal is provided to anyone hungering for fellowship, connection or simply a meal. We have teams of people that serve and host these meals. All are welcome to come and serve a meal or come and receive a meal.
